donorReadme: - Source: USGS Astrogeology Europa Voyager-Galileo SSI Global Mosaic 500m
- License: public domain as a USGS/NASA planetary data product
- Purpose: replace the earlier low-resolution Europa texture with an authoritative 0-360 positive-west simple-cylindrical global map
- Processing: converted from the 19631x9816 8-bit source mosaic to `2048x1024` progressive JPEG

source.licence: public domain as a USGS/NASA planetary data product

coordinates.placement: latLonToXYZ in the donor src/entities/hotspot.ts, on Three.js SphereGeometry UVs
coordinates.longitudeDegrees: exactly as stored in features.json, placed by latLonToXYZ whatever the range; the donor stores values already in its own marker frame (see longitudeRange, markerLongitudeFromSource and donorReadmeNote)
coordinates.position: [radius * sin(phi) * sin(theta), radius * cos(phi), radius * sin(phi) * cos(theta)]
coordinates.conventionNote: donor: the texture is positive-west 0-360 and matches the convention of europa-features.json; formula not stated
coordinates.donorReadmeNote: - The current Europa release uses the USGS/NASA global mosaic at `2K`; the source is simple-cylindrical, planetocentric, positive-west, and 0-360 longitude, matching the coordinate convention used by `data/europa-features.json`.
